dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A distinct concave indentation on the left lateral margin in the posterior third of the visible frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, dark-pixel clusters and localized pitting visible in the lower posterior quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A sharp, transverse shadow-casting crease extending horizontally across the posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal scar or deep epidermal fold in the lower posterior region accompanied by smaller localized lesions.
